summary_en.motivation: To investigate the microstructure, solidification behavior, and mechanical properties of Al-Si-Mg-Ti/TiC alloys fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Different weight fractions of Ti/TiC were added to Al-Si-Mg powder and processed by SLM; microstructural characterization and mechanical testing were performed.
summary_en.result: Addition of Ti/TiC refined the grain structure and enhanced tensile strength and hardness.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical properties were validated by tensile tests and microhardness measurements, supported by SEM and XRD analysis.

papers.title: Pseudotumor in the Setting of Metal-on-Metal Total Hip Arthroplasty
papers.abstract: Metal-on-metal (MoM) hip resurfacing/replacement is a highly discussed topic in arthropathy, and the impact of its complications is still being elucidated. We report the case of a patient who presented with severe stomach pain due to a symptomatic psoas fluid collection that was later shown to communicate with a MoM total hip prosthesis. A MoM pseudotumor presenting as persistent stomach pain due to an aseptic psoas fluid collection is a rare complication. The case may support an earlier diagnosis in at-risk patients, and it outlines a suggested workup and treatment plan.

summary_en.motivation: To report a rare case of pseudotumor presenting as abdominal pain in a patient with a metal-on-metal total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A single case report with associated diagnostic workup and treatment plan.
summary_en.result: Aseptic psoas fluid collection communicating with the hip prosthesis was identified and managed.
